title: EDS Research Receipt
description: Charter §9: R_E = receipt(claim, artifact, source, environment, inputs, execution, outputs, validators).

claim_id.description: The ERC.id this receipt is evidence for.

source_revision.description: Exact SHA that produced the artifact — never a symbolic ref (main/HEAD).

outputs.description: The exact observed output (or a pointer to a stored log).

validators.description: Which validators interpreted the outputs (test framework, SHACL validator, statistical test, human reviewer, etc.).

supports_proposition.description: Which proposition the evidence actually supports — stated narrowly, not generalized beyond what was observed (charter §25).

digest.description: sha256 of the canonicalized receipt body (all fields above, sorted keys, this field excluded) — makes the receipt independently checkable for tampering.
